description: Override how a video is cut: the Creative Director picks per film (`cut_choice` on get_video), so call this only when the person asks for a code film, and leave a film she chose alone otherwise. Its storyboard compiles to a Remotion project (`engine` remotion, version 1 from the compiler, checked and built where the server has Node). The storyboard, media and direction stay as they are; from here the picture is drawn by the project's scenes, which you edit with write_video_code. On a film that exists it brings src/film.json up to date. Read the guide (autopoiesis://guide/code-film) before editing.
name: convert_video_to_code
title: Cut in code
